log_hyperparameters: log model hyperparameters and parameter counts to all Lightning loggers from a config dict
create_logger: create a RankedLogger instance with rank zero only logging enabled for the module
review_log_hyperparameters: review the log_hyperparameters function to understand how it extracts model parameter counts
refactor_log_hyperparameters: refactor log_hyperparameters to support additional config sections or custom hyperparameter keys
test_log_hyperparameters: test log_hyperparameters with a mock Lightning trainer and model to verify parameter counting
